interface.signature: doctorStrange(N: int, M: int, graph: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of sanctums N must be between 1 and 30000.
The number of bridges M must be between 1 and 30000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: All connections in the graph must be between valid sanctum indices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of sanctums whose removal disconnects the graph.
